targets.title: Measuring Black men’s police-based discrimination experiences: Development and validation of the Police and Law Enforcement (PLE) Scale
targets.evidence_quote: This study will attempt to replicate the factor structure of the PLE Scale ( English et al.., 2017 ) in a sample of Black men.
targets.outcome_quote: This study replicates the psychometric functioning of the PLE Scale in Black men.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall verdict about the replicated psychometric functioning in Black men. Other gender/race groups are extensions; prevalence differences are not the central factor-structure test.

reasoning: Independent sample explicitly tests the original 2017 scale factor structure.
